about.history_text: Glory Church Nanshijiao is part of the Way Church (行道會) and is rooted in the Nanshijiao community of Zhonghe District, New Taipei City. Over the years, our congregation has continued to grow into a vibrant community of faith. We believe every person has unique gifts from God and are committed to helping each member discover and live out God's calling.
